# Formatho

> Privacy-first developer tools: 120+ free online utilities that run 100% client-side in the browser. Nothing entered is uploaded, logged, or stored. No account needed.

Every tool page states what the tool does, how to use it step by step, and answers common questions. Free, private, runs in your browser.

## Tools

### Security & Auth

- [TLS Certificate Checker]: https://formatho.com/tools/tls-checker — Check TLS/SSL certificate expiry, issuer, and security configuration. Paste openssl output for instant analysis.
- [SOC 2 Readiness Checklist]: https://formatho.com/tools/soc2-checklist — Interactive checklist covering all 5 Trust Service Criteria with linked tools for each control.
- [Security Policy Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/policy-generator — Generate password, access control, and incident response policies for SOC 2 compliance.
- [Security Headers Analyzer]: https://formatho.com/tools/security-headers — Check HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options and more on any URL. Graded A-F with fix recommendations.
- [CSP Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/csp-generator — Build Content-Security-Policy headers visually. Configure directives and copy the header.
- [CSP Evaluator]: https://formatho.com/tools/csp-evaluator — Analyze a CSP header for weaknesses: unsafe-inline, wildcards, missing directives, bypass risks.
- [CORS Tester]: https://formatho.com/tools/cors-tester — Test cross-origin requests from your browser. See Access-Control-Allow-Origin, methods and headers.
- [Cookie Security Analyzer]: https://formatho.com/tools/cookie-analyzer — Check Set-Cookie headers for Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, prefixes and domain scope.
- [JWT & Auth Toolkit]: https://formatho.com/tools/jwt-suite — Complete auth debugging suite: decode and verify JWTs, inspect claims, build OIDC URLs, decode SAML, generate tokens. All client-side.
- [SAML Request & Response Decoder]: https://formatho.com/tools/saml-decoder — Decode SAML AuthnRequest and Response messages - base64 plus raw-deflate - with pretty-printed XML. Essential for Okta, Entra ID and Shibboleth debugging. 100% client-side.
- [OIDC Authorization URL & PKCE Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/oidc-url-builder — Build OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorize URLs with state, nonce and S256 PKCE code challenges. Works with Okta, Auth0, Entra ID, Keycloak.
- [JWT Debugger]: https://formatho.com/tools/jwt — Decode and inspect JWT tokens instantly.
- [Hash Text]: https://formatho.com/tools/hash-text — Generate Argon2id, bcrypt, PBKDF2, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, BLAKE2b, and Poseidon hashes online. 100% client-side Argon2id password hashing for maximum security.
- [Bcrypt]: https://formatho.com/tools/bcrypt — Generate and verify Bcrypt password hashes.
- [Encrypt/Decrypt]: https://formatho.com/tools/encryption — Encrypt and decrypt text using various algorithms.
- [HMAC Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/hmac-generator — Generate HMAC hash codes with various algorithms.
- [RSA Key Pair]: https://formatho.com/tools/rsa-key-pair-generator — Generate RSA public/private key pairs.
- [Password Strength]: https://formatho.com/tools/password-strength-analyser — Analyze password strength and get improvement suggestions.
- [TOTP Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/otp-code-generator — Generate TOTP codes from secrets. Privacy-first tool.
- [PDF Signature Checker]: https://formatho.com/tools/pdf-signature-checker — Check and validate digital signatures in PDF files. Privacy-first tool.
- [Token Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/token-generator — Generate secure random tokens with customizable length and character sets.
- [Basic Auth Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/basic-auth-generator — Generate HTTP Basic Authentication headers.
- [String Obfuscator]: https://formatho.com/tools/string-obfuscator — Obfuscate strings to hide sensitive data.

### Data Formats

- [JSON Viewer]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-viewer — Format and visualize JSON data.
- [JSON Linter]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-lint — Validate and lint JSON code.
- [JSON Minify]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-minify — Minify JSON to reduce size.
- [JSON <> YAML]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-yaml — Convert JSON to YAML and YAML to JSON instantly.
- [JSON <> CSV]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-csv — Convert JSON to CSV and CSV to JSON format instantly.
- [JSON Diff]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-diff — Compare two JSON objects and see differences.
- [XML Formatter]: https://formatho.com/tools/xml-formatter — Format and prettify XML documents.
- [XML ↔ JSON]: https://formatho.com/tools/xml-json — Bi-directional XML to JSON converter with real-time conversion and clipboard support.
- [YAML Linter]: https://formatho.com/tools/yaml-lint — Validate and lint YAML code.
- [YAML Viewer]: https://formatho.com/tools/yaml-viewer — YAML linter and validator. Format, validate, and beautify YAML documents with real-time syntax checking.
- [TOML to JSON Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/toml-to-json — Convert TOML configuration files to JSON format.
- [JSON to TOML Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-to-toml — json-to-toml - free, privacy-first, and 100% client-side.
- [TOML to YAML Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/toml-to-yaml — Convert TOML configuration files to YAML format.
- [YAML to TOML Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/yaml-to-toml — Convert YAML configuration files to TOML format.
- [UUID Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/uuid — Generate UUIDs (Universally Unique Identifiers). Supports v1, v4, and more.
- [ULID Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/ulid-generator — Generate ULIDs (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers).
- [Base64 String]: https://formatho.com/tools/base64 — Encode and decode Base64 strings instantly.
- [Base64 File]: https://formatho.com/tools/base64-file-converter — Convert files to and from Base64 encoding.
- [Phone Parser]: https://formatho.com/tools/phone-parser — Parse and format phone numbers.
- [IBAN Validator]: https://formatho.com/tools/iban-validator — Validate and parse International Bank Account Numbers.
- [Email Normalizer]: https://formatho.com/tools/email-normalizer — email-normalizer - free, privacy-first, and 100% client-side.
- [List Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/list-converter — Convert lists between different formats (comma, newline, JSON, etc).

- [Text Diff Checker]: https://formatho.com/tools/diff — Compare two texts and see differences.
- [Text Statistics]: https://formatho.com/tools/text-statistics — Count characters, words, sentences, and paragraphs.
- [Image Compressor]: https://formatho.com/tools/image — Compress and optimize images.
- [Camera Recorder]: https://formatho.com/tools/camera-recorder — Record video from your webcam.
- [SVG Placeholder Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/svg-placeholder-generator — Generate SVG placeholder images.
- [Agent Identity Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/agent-identity-generator — Instantly generate unique personas, traits, and system prompts for AI agents.

- [Integer Base Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/integer-base-converter — Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal.
- [Roman Numerals]: https://formatho.com/tools/roman-numeral-converter — Convert between Roman numerals and Arabic numbers.
- [Color Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/color-converter — Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and other formats.
- [Case Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/case-converter — Convert text between different cases (camelCase, snake_case, etc.).

- [Text to Unicode Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/text-to-unicode — Convert text to Unicode code points and HTML entities.
- [Temperature]: https://formatho.com/tools/temperature-converter — Convert temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, and Rankine.
- [Math Evaluator]: https://formatho.com/tools/math-evaluator — Evaluate mathematical expressions.
